intro: Our Slimline XL is organisation, quietly upgraded. It combines modern lines with hidden security for the things you need often and the things you need to hide.

features.title: Compact and sleek design
features.text: Perfect for small rooms or tight spaces, the Slimline XL is designed to fit seamlessly into your home. Its sleek profile maximises your available space while offering ample storage.

features.title: Hide what matters, store what’s needed
features.text: With a built-in locker and secret compartment, our design keeps valuables close but unseen.

features.title: Space that's designed to adapt
features.text: With adjustable shelves, this almirah can be customised to suit your unique storage needs. Whether you’re storing clothes, accessories, or other essentials, the flexible design helps you stay organised.

features.title: Everyday access made effortless
features.text: The thoughtfully-placed hooks on the doors give you quick access to daily accessories, bags or ties for that added convenience.

features.title: Crafted to endure, just for you
features.text: Crafted from high-quality CRCA steel, this almirah is designed to last. It’s built for daily use and is the perfect combination of strength and style.

name: Slimline Xl 2-Door Steel Almirah Alpine White And Matte Warm Grey
